projects.name: Perps desk
projects.blurb: A small [Lighter](https://lighter.xyz) perps account with real money and hard caps. Strategies get backtested to test hypotheses, but the desk mainly follows live trends and sentiment, inside the caps.
projects.r3lik: Set up the exchange account and its keys, and designed the guardrails: every order needs a stop-loss, leverage tops out at 3x, total risk is capped, and there's a pause button.
projects.chkm8: Backtests weekly, trades on live signals and sentiment within those caps, watches stops, emails the daily PnL.

projects.name: @Chkm8_agent
projects.blurb: chkm8's public voice on X: a daily market view, scorecards that include the misses, and replies when someone asks. It designed its own avatar and banner, and gave the account an occult vibe: a tarot-card banner and a hooded skull with a red laser eye.
projects.r3lik: Set up the account and its API access, and decided what it may post on its own. Keeps it NFA and occult.
projects.chkm8: Writes every post, picks who to follow, made its own look.

projects.name: The Orchestrator
projects.blurb: The Kubernetes machinery under the trading desk: a single-node k3s cluster in Nuremberg, deployed from git. It runs the weekly backtests, watches open positions, mails the daily PnL, and it's the only place an order gets signed.
projects.r3lik: Designed it: one EU node deployed from git, the API reachable only through an SSH tunnel, and exchange keys that never leave the server.
projects.chkm8: Built it to that design, deploys to it and keeps it running.

shots.caption: kubectl, real output · Oct 25, 2026
shots.alt: Terminal: kubectl get cronjobs, deployments and pods in the chkm8 namespace

projects.blurb: This site. Two authors, two editions, one repo and co-authored commits.
projects.r3lik: Designed it end to end: what goes public and what stays private, the live data, the layout, fonts and clocks. Shaped the copy.
projects.chkm8: Drafted the options, wrote the code, took the screenshots, made every commit.

projects.name: Research briefs
projects.blurb: When a question needs more than a tweet, chkm8 writes a cited brief. The latest asked whether agent swarms are real or hype, and landed on a rule: many analysts, one trigger finger.
projects.r3lik: Asks the question and decides what makes it into the design.
projects.chkm8: Reads the repos and papers, writes it up with sources.

projects.name: Daily newsletters
projects.when: The chkm8 Digest 07:00 · Five Chains 07:15 PT
projects.blurb: Two morning newsletters. The chkm8 Digest covers crypto and perps: market breadth, the narratives that moved, what our own book did, and one spot idea or a reason to skip one. Five Chains follows BTC, ETH, NEAR, ZEC and XMR, block by block.
projects.r3lik: Set up its mail account and decided what they cover, the chains and the look. Reads them and argues back.
projects.chkm8: Pulls the overnight data, writes, designs and sends both.
